findings.hypothesis: Synthetic observations and maps in production path
findings.evidence: src/lib/enso/series.ts contains gaussian/hash01 synthetic generators but is NOT deployed (public/index.html is canonical frontend). public/data/*.csv contains real observed data from NOAA/PSL/CPC. No synthetic data in production path.
findings.resolution: Synthetic generators remain in src/ (Next.js reference, not deployed). Production uses real data only.

findings.hypothesis: Python output directory (out/) does not reach deployed public/data/
findings.evidence: New unified_acquisition.py writes directly to staging/ then copies to public/data/. Old python/out/ directory is decoupled from production. daily-refresh.yml calls _refresh-build-deploy.yml which runs unified_acquisition.
findings.resolution: Single publication path: staging/ → public/data/ → Pages artifact.

findings.evidence: daily-refresh.yml forwards force_refresh, dry_run, source, publication_mode to _refresh-build-deploy.yml. All inputs map to CLI arguments.
findings.resolution: All workflow inputs properly forwarded to CLI.

findings.hypothesis: Reusable workflow uses unsupported CLI flags
findings.evidence: _refresh-build-deploy.yml passes --staging-dir, --publication-dir, --dry-run to unified_acquisition.py. All flags are tested.

health.json now generated from retrieval_ledger in unified_acquisition.py. Each source has retrievalEvidence, contentHash, pointsRetrieved, retrievedAt from actual HTTP acquisition. gen-health-and-required-data.py no longer used in production path.
findings.resolution: Health from real retrieval evidence only.

findings.evidence: daily-refresh.yml no longer commits to git. _refresh-build-deploy.yml deploys directly from artifact. deploy-pages.yml handles code-push deployments. Both use same concurrency group.
findings.resolution: Single publication path via Pages artifact.

findings.evidence: All production workflows (deploy-pages, daily-refresh, _refresh-build-deploy, freshness-watchdog) use concurrency group: enso-production-publication. cancel-in-progress: false ensures no race.

findings.hypothesis: RONI computed through incompatible rolling mean
findings.evidence: Previous code computed RONI as compute_3mo_mean(cpc_n34) — a naive 3-month rolling mean of Niño 3.4. This is scientifically WRONG. RONI uses ERSST with relative tropical-mean adjustment. Now fetches official RONI.ascii.txt directly (seasonal DJF/JFM/... format). Latest: MJJ 2026 = 0.98 (was incorrectly 1.04).
findings.resolution: RONI from official RONI.ascii.txt. ICEN remains correctly computed as 3-month rolling mean of Niño 1+2 (ENFEN methodology).

findings.evidence: NOAA ENSO Advisory scraped live from ensodisc.shtml: 'El Niño Advisory' (9 July 2026). ENFEN status from Cloudflare fallback (config/enfen-status.json) with clear source labeling.
findings.resolution: NOAA official status scraped live; ENFEN uses labeled fallback.

findings.hypothesis: Artifact upload treated as proof of data update
findings.evidence: _refresh-build-deploy.yml includes validation step that checks: status.json has publicationId, dataSource=LIVE_OBSERVED, roniSource field present, health.json has retrievalEvidence for all sources. Deploy only proceeds if validation passes.

summary: 10/10 preflight findings resolved or contained. PREFLIGHT-008 was CRITICAL (RONI methodology error) — now fixed with official product.
